text:
A man is on trial for cannibalism.
He says to the judge,
"Well, your honor, if you truly are what you eat, then I am an innocent man."
gist: Accused cannibal pleads innocent by citing 'you are what you eat', implying he ate innocent men.

text:
My grandpa just walked into my room with a young guy wearing skinny jeans and eating avocado toast.
I said, “Who is this guy?”
Grandpa: This is my hip replacement.
gist: A grandpa introduces a young hipster as his 'hip replacement', literalizing the surgery as swapping himself for someone hip.

text:
A student visits the principal’s office one day and the principal says to him, “What’s your name, son?” He replies, “D-d-d-dav-dav-david, sir.” The principal looks up and asks him, “Oh, do you have a stutter?”
The student replies, “No sir, my dad has a stutter, but the guy who registered my name was an asshole.”
gist: A boy who seems to stutter his name explains he does not stutter: his stuttering father said it and the registrar spitefully wrote it down that way.

text:
Finding a woman sobbing that she had locked her keys in her car
a passing soldier assures her that he can help. She looks on amazed as he removes his trousers, rolls them into a tight ball and rubs them against the car door.
Magically it opens.......
"That's so clever," the woman gasps. "How did you do it?"
"Easy," replies the soldier. "These are my khakis".
gist: A soldier opens a woman's locked car by rubbing his trousers on the door, explaining they are his 'khakis', punning on car keys.

text:
An angry wife says to her husband " I should've married the devil he would've made a better husband than you!"
The husband responds "you would've been arrested because marriage between relatives is illegal in this country"
gist: A wife says she should have married the devil; the husband replies marriage between relatives is illegal, implying she is the devil's kin.

text:
My wife was dying.
I was by her bedside.
She said in a tired voice, "Theres something I must confess."
"Shhh" I said, "theres nothing to confess. Everythings alright."
"No I must die in peace. I had sex with your brother, your best friend, his best friend and your father."
"I know," I whispered, "Thats why I poisoned you."
gist: Dying wife confesses to cheating with all his family and friends; husband calmly says he knows, which is why he poisoned her.

text:
My friend just asked me, "If you became invisible, what would you do first?"
I said, "I'd go to Paris, find a performing street mime and beat the shit out of him;  the round of applause he'd get would be astounding."
gist: Asked what he'd do if invisible, a man says he'd beat up a street mime, since the crowd would applaud the mime's convincing act.

text:
An elderly couple is in church. The wife says to the husband, "I've let out one of those silent farts, what do I do?"
The husband says, "Change the battery in your hearing aid."
gist: In church an old wife whispers she just passed silent gas; husband says to change the battery in her hearing aid, since it wasn't silent.

text:
My wife said to me: "If you won the lottery, would you still love me?"
I said: "Of course I would. I'd miss you, but I'd still love you."
gist: Wife asks if he'd still love her after winning the lottery; husband says yes, he'd miss her but still love her, revealing he'd leave.

text:
I bumped into an old school friend today. He started showing off, talking about his well paid job and expensive sports car.
Then he pulled out a photo of his wife and said, "She's beautiful, isn't she?"
I said, "If you think she's gorgeous, you should see my girlfriend."
He said, "Why? Is she a stunner?"
I said, "No, she's a fucking optician."
gist: Boastful old friend shows his wife's photo; speaker says he should see his girlfriend, who is an optician, implying he needs his eyes checked.

text:
Two blind pilots enter a plane.
They have sunglasses and white sticks. As the plane starts to move, the passengers are uncomfortable. The plane gains speed, but it stays on the ground. The remaining runway gets smaller and smaller, and the plane is rushing towards a fence.
The passengers start shrieking and suddenly the plane lifts, avoiding the fence at the last second. All the passengers calm down, thinking it was a bad joke.
In the pilot cabin, the co-pilot turns to the pilot and says : "You know what? One day they're going to scream too late, and we're all going to die."
gist: Two blind pilots take off only when passengers scream at the runway's end, and worry that one day the screaming will come too late.

text:
I had a vasectomy because I didn't want to have kids.
But when I came back home, they were still there.
gist: Man gets a vasectomy because he didn't want to have kids, then is disappointed his existing kids are still at home.

text:
A lawyer gets pulled over by a police officer.
The officer asks the lawyer "Do you know why I pulled you over?"
"I haven't the foggiest idea," said the lawyer.
The officer replied, "You didn't make a full stop at the stop sign back there. You only slowed down."
The lawyer thinks for a few seconds then says, "If you can prove to me the difference between stopping and slowing down, I'll take full responsibility. Otherwise, you let me off with a warning. Sound fair?"
The officer ponders it shortly before nodding his head. "Sounds fair. Can you step out of the car please?"
Just as the lawyer steps out and shuts the car door, the officer pulls out his baton and starts beating the lawyer. After a few swings, the officer says, "Now, would you like me to stop or slow down?"
gist: A lawyer challenges a cop to prove the difference between stopping and slowing down, so the cop beats him with a baton and asks whether he should stop or slow down.

text:
Interviewer: "I heard you were extremely quick at math"
Me: "yes, as a matter of fact I am"
Interviewer: "Whats 14x27"
Me: "49"
Interviewer: "that's not even close"
me: "yeah, but it was fast"
gist: A job candidate who claims to be quick at math blurts a wildly wrong answer and defends it as at least being fast.

text:
I met a girl crying outside a mall.
I asked her what's wrong, she said she lost 200$. So I gave her 40$ from the 200$ I picked up at the entrance.
When god blesses you, you must bless others.
gist: A man 'kindly' gives a crying girl who lost $200 forty dollars out of the very $200 he found at the entrance.

text:
My grandpa started walking five miles a day when he was 60...
Now he's 97 years old and we have no idea where the hell he is.
gist: Grandpa took up walking five miles daily at sixty, and decades later the family has no idea where he has walked off to.

text:
I told my therapist that i am having suicidal thoughts
He now makes me pay in advance
gist: After a patient admits suicidal thoughts, his therapist's only reaction is to demand payment in advance.

text:
If I make you breakfast in bed, a simple "thank you" is all I need.
Not all this "how did you get in my house??!!!" business.
gist: A man asks only for thanks for breakfast in bed, not the fuss about how he broke into the woman's house.

text:
My girlfriend left a note on the fridge
"This is not working I'm going to my mum's house."
So, I opened the fridge's door, the light came on and the juice was cold.
- What the hell did she mean?
gist: Girlfriend's breakup note on the fridge says 'this is not working', so he checks the fridge, finds it working and is baffled.

text: The school phoned me today and said, "Your son's has been telling lies. " I replied,  "Tell him, he's bloody good. I don't have any kids."
gist: A school reports that a man's son tells lies, and he praises the boy's skill because he has no children.

text:
I Will Never Forget My Son's First Words
Where the fuck have you been for 16 years?
gist: A father fondly recalls his son's first words, which were an angry question about where he had been for sixteen years.

text:
An MIT linguistics professor was lecturing his class the other day.
"In English," he said, "a double negative forms a positive. However, in some languages, such as Russian, a double negative remains a negative. But there isn't a single language, not one, in which a double positive can express a negative."
A voice from the back of the room said, "Yeah, right."
gist: A linguistics professor claims no language lets a double positive mean a negative, and a student refutes him with a sarcastic 'yeah, right'.

text: Cop: I’m arresting you for illegally downloading the entire Wikipedia! Man: Wait, I can explain everything!
gist: A man arrested for downloading all of Wikipedia protests that he can explain everything.

text:
At breakfast, a man asked his wife “What would you do I if won the lottery?” She replied, “I’d take half, and then leave you.”
“Great,” he said “I won $12 yesterday. Here’s $6. Stay in touch.”
gist: A wife says she would take half of any lottery win and leave, so the husband hands her half of his tiny win and bids her goodbye.

text:
One day a man hears that a distant uncle passed away
He's a little sad, but only a little, for they barely knew each other. Then, a few days later, a package arrives. It contains his inheritance from the estate: A violin and a painting. He has no idea what to do with them. After pondering the matter, he takes them to an appraiser. Not too long later the appraiser calls him: "I've finished my analysis, and I've got some good news. There's no doubt at all that what you have is a genuine Van Gogh and a genuine Stradivarius." The man is ecstatic: "I can sell these for millions!" The appraiser says "Well, you can sell them, and they'll fetch some money for their novelty value. But not millions. You see, the truth is, Stradivarius wasn't much of a painter... and Van Gogh made lousy violins."
gist: A man inherits a genuine Stradivarius and a genuine Van Gogh, but the appraiser explains the painting is by Stradivarius and the violin by Van Gogh.

text:
My boss arrived at work in a brand-new Lamborghini.
I said, "Wow, that's an amazing car!"
He replied, "If you work hard, put all your hours in, and strive for excellence, I'll get another one next year".
gist: A boss with a new Lamborghini tells an employee that if he works hard all year, the boss will be able to buy another one.

text:
My wife found me in the kitchen naked holding a gun
"What the hell are you doing?" she screamed, shocked at my appearance.
"Quiet woman! I'm hunting decepticons!" I whispered back harshly.
She put her hands on her hips. "You've been sleep walking again! There are no such thing as decepticons!"
I blinked, realizing how stupid I looked.
"I guess you're right! Man I must look like and idiot!" I said.
She laughed.
I laughed.
The toaster laughed.
I shot the toaster.
gist: A sleepwalking husband hunting Transformers is talked down by his wife until the toaster laughs along and he shoots it.

text:
Sitting beside my girlfriend I said, "I love you."
She said, "Is that you or the beer talking?"
I said, "It's me talking to the beer."
gist: Asked whether it is him or the beer saying 'I love you', a man says it is him talking to the beer.

text:
The police called to tell me that my wife was in the hospital.
"How is she?" I asked
"Very critical," replied the officer
"The fuck is she complaining about now?"
gist: Police tell a husband his wife in hospital is 'very critical', and he takes it as her being judgmental, asking what she is complaining about now.

text:
Little Johnny was told by his friends that adults have a deep dark secret and can be easily manipulated.
Johnny decides to test it. He comes home, goes up to his mother and says, "Mom, I know everything." Mom shushes him and gives him $10.
"Just don't tell Dad" she says.
*Hey, it's working* thinks Little Johnny.
An hour later, Dad comes home from work. Johnny goes up to him and says: "Dad, I know everything."
Dad gives Johnny $100. "Don't tell Mom" he says.
Just then, the mailman knocks on the door. Johnny opens it and says. "I know everything, Mister."
The mailman drops all his mail, his eyes tear up  and he says:
"Well then Johnny, come give Daddy a hug."
gist: A boy tells each adult 'I know everything' and collects hush money from mom and dad, until the mailman reveals he is the boy's real father.

text:
My son is three years old and I took him shopping.
When we got home, he had a chocolate bar in his pocket. Now, I didn't buy it and he certainly didn't buy it, so I marched him straight back to the shopping centre and went to the jewellers.
gist: A father finds his toddler shoplifted a chocolate bar and, instead of returning it, marches him back to the mall's jewelry store to steal bigger.

text:
At a funeral
Me: "Do you mind if I say a word?"
Widow: "Please do."
Me: *clears throat* "Plethora."
Widow: "Thank you. That means a lot."
gist: At a funeral a man asks to 'say a word' and literally says one word, 'plethora', which the widow thanks him for because it 'means a lot'.

text:
My son was just born and another dad at the nursery congratulated me and said his daughter was born yesterday. He said; maybe they’ll marry each other.
Sure, like my son is going to marry someone twice his age...
gist: A dad of a day-old girl suggests their newborns might marry, and the other father scoffs that his son won't marry a woman twice his age.

text:
A 911 operator is sitting at her desk when she gets a call.
"911 What's your emergency?" She answers.
"My friend and I were walking through the woods when he just collapsed. I think he died." A man responds. He is very nervous
"Ok, calm down. First, make sure he's dead." The operator replies.
There's a silence on the phone. Then, there's a gunshot.
The man then says, "OK, now what?"
gist: Emergency operator tells a caller to make sure his collapsed friend is dead, and he takes it literally by shooting him.

text:
Job interviewer: Where do you see yourself in 5 years?
Me: I would say my biggest weakness is listening.
gist: Job candidate answers the 'where do you see yourself in five years' question with a canned weakness answer, proving his weakness is listening.

text:
A wife asks her husband, “Honey, if I died, would you remarry?”
“After a considerable period of grieving, I guess I would. We all need companionship.”
“If I died and you remarried,” the wife asks, “would she live in this house?”
“We’ve spent a lot of money getting this house just the way we want it. I’m not going to get rid of my house. I guess she would.”
“If I died and you remarried, and she lived in this house,” the wife asks, “would she sleep in our bed?”
“Well, the bed is brand new, and it cost us $2,000. It’s going to last along time, so I guess she would.”
“If I died and you remarried, and she lived in this house and slept in our bed, would she use my golf clubs?”
“Oh, no,” the husband replies. "She's left-handed!"
gist: Wife quizzes husband about remarrying; he calmly lets the new wife have the house and bed but not her golf clubs, because the new woman is left-handed, revealing he already has someone.

text:
During a visit to the mental asylum, I asked the director how do You determine whether or not a patient should be institutionalized.
"Well," said the director, "we fill up a bathtub, then we offer a teaspoon, a teacup and a bucket to the patient and ask him or her to empty the bathtub."
"Oh, I understand," I said. "A normal person would use the bucket because it's bigger than the spoon or the teacup."
"No." said the director, "A normal person would pull the bathtub drain plug. Do you want a bed near the window?"
gist: Asylum director's bathtub test: the visitor confidently picks the bucket, but a normal person would pull the plug, so the director offers him a bed.

text:
2 blind guys were about to fight
I shouted: I bet the one with the knife wins!
Both started running away.
gist: Bystander yells that the blind fighter with the knife will win, and both unarmed blind men flee.

text:
"Son you're just not cut out to be a mime."
"Is it something I said?"
"Yes."
gist: A father tells his son he will never make a mime, and when the son asks if it is something he said, the literal answer is yes.

text:
They all laughed when I told them that one day I would discover the secrets of invisibility
If only they could see me now!
gist: A scientist mocked for promising to discover invisibility wishes his critics could see him now, which they literally cannot.

text:
A man went into a library and asked for a book on how to commit suicide.
The librarian said: "fuck off, you won't bring it back"
gist: A man asks a librarian for a book on suicide and she refuses because he would never return it.

text:
Wiki joke
Officer: “I’m arresting you for downloading all of Wikipedia”
Man: “No wait! I can explain everything!”
gist: A man arrested for downloading all of Wikipedia protests that he can explain everything, which is now literally true.

text:
So was at a bar last night and saw this fat chick wearing a shirt that said, "Caution, I'm a maneater". I walked up to the girl and timidly said, "Excuse me, Miss...about your shirt."
She interrupted me before I could continue and furiously shouted, "Oh let me guess, you're here to make a comment about how I'm so fat and how I actually eat men. I can't help my weight you know. I have feelings too and your comments can really hurt."
I looked at her, confused and said,"That's actually not what I was going to say at all."
"Oh…" she replied as a smile started to come across her face. "What were you going to say?"
"That's not how you spell manatee."
gist: A heavy woman in a 'maneater' shirt expects a fat joke from a man, but he only wanted to point out that she misspelled 'manatee'.

text: When I turned 16, my dad told me it was time to get a job. “When I was your age, my very first job I had I worked with over 500 people under me.”... “Wow!” I said. “Was it some big corporation?”“No.” He replied, “I mowed the lawn in the cemetery.”
gist: A father boasts that his first job had 500 people under him, which turns out to mean mowing a cemetery lawn.

text:
Doctor: Well, it looks like you're pregnant.
Woman: Oh my God, I'm pregnant?!
Doctor: No, it just looks like you are.
FP Edit: RIP my inbox
gist: A doctor says a woman looks pregnant, and when she rejoices he clarifies she only looks pregnant, meaning she is fat.

text:
A dog runs up to their master carrying an unusual stick.
Master: Hey boy, what do you got there?
Dog: *Bark*
Master: Bark? Well where did you get such an unusual piece of bark?
Dog: *Ruff*
Master: The roof? Well how did you get all the way up there?
Dog: *With the ladder*
gist: An owner reads his dog's barks as answers (bark, roof), until the dog plainly says it used the ladder.

text:
A little old lady goes to the doctor and says, “Doctor, I have a terrible problem with gas, but it doesn’t bother me much.”
My farts are always silent and never smell. I probably farted 15 times since I’ve been here, and you didn’t realize it.
The doctor says, “Interesting. Why don’t you take these pills and come see me in a week?”
The old lady returns in a week and says, “I don’t know what the hell you gave me. My farts are still silent, but my God, they stink!!”
The doctor says, “Excellent. Now that your sinuses are cleared, let’s work on your hearing.”
gist: An old woman sure her farts are odorless gets pills, comes back complaining they now stink, and the doctor says her sinuses are fixed and her hearing is next.

text:
My neighboor rang my doorbell at 5 am..
Luckily I was already up, playing drums.
gist: A neighbor rings the bell at 5 am, and the speaker is relieved he was already awake, revealing his drumming is why the neighbor came.

text:
I asked a pretty, young, homeless woman if I could take her home, and she said yes with a big smile.
The look on her face soon changed when I walked off with her cardboard box.
gist: A man asks a homeless woman if he can take her home, she agrees happily, and he walks off with her cardboard box.

text:
My boyfriend was dying. I was by his bedside when he said something with a weak voice, "There's something I must confess."
"Shhh" I said "There's nothing to confess. Everything is alright."
"No, I must die in peace" he said, "I had sex with your sister, your best friend and your co-worker."
"I know" I whispered, "That's why I poisoned you... Now close your eyes."
gist: A dying boyfriend confesses cheating with everyone close to her, and she calmly reveals that is why she poisoned him.

text:
My boss said to me, "you're the worst train driver ever. How many have you derailed this year?"
I said, "I'm not sure; it's hard to keep track."
gist: A train driver asked how many trains he derailed says it is hard to keep track.

text:
Cop on horse says to little girl on bike, "Did Santa get you that?"
"Yes," replies the little girl.
"Well tell him to put a reflector light on it next year!" and fines her $5.
The little girl looks up at the cop and says, "Nice horse you've got there, did Santa bring you that?"
The cop chuckles and replies, "He sure did!"
"Well," says the little girl, "Next year tell Santa that the d*ck goes under the horse, not on top of it!"
gist: Mounted cop fines a little girl for a bike without a reflector and mocks it as Santa's gift; she retorts that Santa put the dick on top of the horse instead of under it, calling the cop a dick.

text:
My wife was in labour and started shouting "Wouldn't, couldn't, shouldn't, didn't, can't!"
"Don't worry" said the midwife "they're just contractions"
gist: Woman in labor shouts grammatical contractions, and the midwife reassures that they are just contractions.

text:
A man is showing off his new apartment...
After a night at the bar, he brings his friends up, where he has large brass gong and a mallet.
"What's with the gong and mallet?" One of his friends asked.
"It's not a gong, it's a talking clock," the man replied.
"A talking clock? Seriously?"
"Yup."
"How's it work?" The friend asked
"Watch," said the man. He picked up the mallet and banged the gong as hard as he could, stepping back as the pound reverberated around the room.
The friends looked at the man, rather confused.
Suddenly, someone on the other side of the wall started screaming "You bastard! It's 3 in the morning!"
gist: Man shows friends his 'talking clock', a gong he bangs at night, and the furious neighbor screams the time through the wall.

text:
My girlfriend accused me of cheating
I told her she was starting to sound like my wife.
gist: Girlfriend accuses man of cheating, and he replies she's starting to sound like his wife, confirming it.

text:
Last night I was out for a few drinks.
One thing lead to another and I had a few too many cocktails and then went onto the wine. Not a good idea.
Knowing I was over the limit, I decided to leave my car at the pub and took a bus home.
Sure enough, I passed a police checkpoint, where they were pulling over drivers and performing breathalyzer tests. Because I was in a Bus they just waved it past.
I arrived home safely and without incident, which was a real surprise as I've never driven a bus before and I am not even sure where I got it from.
gist: Drunk man proudly leaves his car and takes a bus home past a police checkpoint, then admits he has never driven a bus and doesn't know where he got it.

text:
My wife is threatening to kick me out of the house because of my obsession with acting like a news anchor.
More on this after the break.
gist: Man says his wife may kick him out over his news-anchor habit, then defers the story with 'more after the break'.

text:
My neighbor. She’s single. She’s shapely & beautiful and she lives right across the street.
I watched her as she got home from work this evening. I was surprised when she walked across the street, up my driveway and knocked on my door.
I opened the door, she looked at me and said, ”I just got home, and I have this strong urge to have a good time, get drunk, and have fun tonight. Are you doing anything?”
I quickly replied, “Nope, I’m free!”
“Great” she said. ”Can you watch my dog?”
gist: Beautiful neighbor tells the man she wants to party tonight and asks if he's free; he eagerly says yes and she asks him to dog-sit.

text:
A guy said to God, "God, is it true that to you a billion years is like a second?"
God said yes.
The guy said, "God, is it true that to you a billion dollars is like a penny?"
God said yes.
The guy said, "God, can I have a penny?"
God said, "Sure, just a second."
gist: A man confirms that to God a billion years is a second and a billion dollars a penny, asks for a penny, and God replies just a second.

text:
At a wedding I whispered to a guy next to me,
"Isn't the bride a right ugly dog"
"Do you mind. That's my daughter you're talking about"
"I'm sorry, I didn't know you were her father''...
"I'm not . . . I'm her fucking mother.
gist: At a wedding a guest insults the bride to a man next to him, apologizes for insulting her father, and learns the masculine-looking person is her mother.

text:
A girl once told me, “If you lost about 50 pounds you’d be cute”
I told her, “if I lost 50 pounds I’d be talking to your friends!”
gist: A woman says he would be cute if he lost weight, and he retorts that then he would be talking to her prettier friends.

text:
Bad Math Grade
A little boy comes home from school and tells his father, "I got an F in math today."
His father replies, "What happened?"
The boy says, "Well, my teacher asked me, 'What's 3 times 2', and I said 6.'"
The father replies, "Well, that's correct."
The boy says, "I know. Then she asked me, 'What's 2 times 3.'"
The father then replies, "What the fuck is the difference?"
The boys says, "That's what I said!"
gist: Boy failed math after asking what the difference is between 3 times 2 and 2 times 3, and his father's swearing reaction repeats exactly what the boy said.

text:
A wife asks her programmer husband to go to the store..
'Can you go down to the store, and get a gallon of milk, and if they have eggs, get 6.'
Later on he returns home and she looks at his purchases and says 'Why the fuck do you have 6 gallons of milk?'
He responded 'They had eggs.'
gist: Programmer told to buy milk and, if there are eggs, get six, parses it literally and returns with six gallons of milk because the store had eggs.

text:
I was walking with my girlfriend when a random guy whistled at her and said "nice ass". She was clearly annoyed and demanded I say something.
So I turned around and said: "Thank you I've been doing squats"
gist: A stranger whistles 'nice ass' at a man's girlfriend, she demands he respond, and he thanks the stranger as if the compliment were for himself.

text:
"Mom? Don't freak out, but I'm in the hospital..."
"Peter, you've been a doctor for over 8 years now, please stop starting every phone conversation we have with that."
gist: Son calls mom saying 'don't freak out, I'm in the hospital', and she reminds him he's been a doctor there for years.

text:
I went to the doctors recently He said: “Don’t eat anything fatty” I said: “What, like bacon and burgers?”
He said, “No. Fatty, don’t eat anything."
gist: Doctor's advice 'don't eat anything fatty' turns out to be 'Fatty, don't eat anything', addressed to the patient.

text:
To this day, the boy that used to bully me at school still takes my lunch money.
On the plus side, he makes great Subway sandwiches.
gist: A man says his school bully still takes his lunch money, then reveals it is because the bully now works behind a sandwich-shop counter.

text:
A man is buying a banana, an apple and two eggs. The female cashier says: "You must be single."
The man answers: "Wow, how did you know?"
Cashier: "Because you're ugly."
gist: A cashier guesses a man is single from his tiny grocery basket, and when he marvels at her deduction she says it is simply because he is ugly.

text:
A nice, calm and respectable lady went into the pharmacy, right up to the pharmacist, looked straight into his eyes, and said, "I would like to buy some cyanide."
The pharmacist asked, "Why in the world do you need cyanide?"
The lady replied, "I need it to poison my husband."
The pharmacists eyes got big and he exclaimed, "Lord have mercy! I can't give you cyanide to kill your husband! That's against the law! I'll lose my license! They'll throw both of us in jail! All kinds of bad things will happen. Absolutely not! You CANNOT have any cyanide!"
The lady reached into her purse and pulled out a picture of her husband in bed with the pharmacist's wife.
The pharmacist looked at the picture and replied, "Well now. That's different. You didn't tell me you had a prescription."
gist: A pharmacist refuses to sell a woman poison to kill her husband until she shows a photo of her husband in bed with the pharmacist's wife, which he accepts as a prescription.

text:
Asked My Parents if I was an accident
Mom: No, no, why would you think that?
Dad: It was a more of a tragedy, really.
gist: A child asks whether they were an accident; mom denies it, and dad says it was more of a tragedy.

text:
A gorgeous young brunette goes into the doctor’s office and said that her body hurt wherever she touched it.
“Impossible!” says the doctor. “Show me”.
“The brunette took her finger, pushed on her left wrist and screamed,then she pushed her elbow and screamed in even more.
She pushed her knee and screamed; likewise she pushed her ankle and screamed.
Everywhere she touched made her scream.
The doctor said, “You’re not really a brunette, are you?”
“Well, no” she said, “I’m actually a blonde.”
“I thought so,” the doctor said. “Your finger is broken”.
gist: A woman says everything she touches hurts; the doctor guesses she is really a blonde and finds the real problem is her broken finger.

text:
"Hey son, what has 4 legs and doesn’t breathe?”
“You’re not fooling me dad, a chair!”
“Not this time, your dog died.”
gist: A father poses a riddle about something with four legs that doesn't breathe; the son confidently answers 'a chair', but the answer is the family dog that died.

text:
A woman’s on vacation and calls home
She asks her husband, "How’s my cat doing?"
The husband says, "The cat’s dead."
The woman’s upset and says, "Well, you could have broken the news to me when I got home. I can’t enjoy my vacation now. You could’ve just said a little white lie, like the cat’s on the roof and you can’t get her down."
"Okay, I’m sorry," says the husband, "I’ll remember that."
The woman says, "Anyway, how’s my mother doing?"
The husband says, "Your mother’s on the roof and we can’t get her down."
gist: A wife scolds her husband for bluntly reporting the cat's death instead of easing her in with 'it's on the roof', and he applies the lesson to her mother.

text: My wife caught me standing on the bathroom scale, sucking in my stomach... “Ha­­! That’s not going to help,” she said.“Sure, it does,” I said. “It’s the only way I can see the numbers.”
gist: A wife mocks her husband for sucking in his stomach on the scale, and he explains it is the only way he can see the numbers.

text: Mum, dad, I'm gay Mum: *looks at dad*Dad: *clenches fist and sweats*Mum: No, don-Dad: HI GAY I'M DAD
gist: A son comes out as gay, mom fears dad's reaction, and dad cannot resist answering with the 'Hi X, I'm Dad' joke.

text: I came home and saw a note from my wife stuck on the fridge: “I’m sorry. This isn’t working. You take things too literally. Goodbye.” She will be so happy when she finds out I ordered a new one.
gist: A wife's breakup note on the fridge says 'this isn't working' and complains he is too literal, and he takes it as the fridge being broken and orders a new one.

text: I lost my job at the bank my very first day A woman asked me to check her balance so I pushed her over
gist: A new bank clerk is fired on day one for pushing over a woman who asked him to check her balance, taking it as physical balance.

text: The recipe said, “Set the oven to 180 degrees.” Now I can’t open the oven, as the door faces the wall.
gist: Following a recipe to set the oven to 180 degrees, the cook rotates the oven so its door faces the wall.

text: My therapist told me that I have trouble interpreting social cues. I think she’s in love with me.
gist: Patient told he misreads social cues immediately misreads his therapist as being in love with him.

text: A kid lights his house on fire. Dad: *putting arm around his wife, both tearing up* That’s arson.
gist: Child sets the house on fire and the tearful parents proudly say 'That's arson', which sounds like 'that's our son'.

text: Her: You got a vasectomy without talking to me? Are you serious? Him: Yes, I’m not kidding you.
gist: Wife asks if husband is serious about his secret vasectomy, and he says he is 'not kidding', i.e. not joking and not having kids.

text: We were watching a documentary on African wildlife, and my son asked me, “Is it difficult to spot cheetahs?” Me: No, I think they come that way.
gist: Son asks if cheetahs are hard to spot, and dad says no, they come that way, reading 'spot' as giving spots.

text: I want to die like my grandpa did, in his sleep. Not screaming like the people in the back seat of his car.
gist: Speaker wishes to die peacefully in his sleep like grandpa, then reveals grandpa was driving and his passengers died screaming.

text: I was at a restaurant with my wife when a waitress suddenly screamed, "Does anyone know CPR??" I shouted, "Even better, I know the whole alphabet!"Everyone laughed...Well, everyone except this one guy.
gist: When a waitress asks if anyone knows CPR, a diner jokes he knows the whole alphabet, and the choking man is the only one not laughing.

text: My daughter was having a pretend dinner party with her teddy bear... She asked, “Do you want anything to eat, Mr. Bear?”In my best bear voice, I replied, “No thanks, I’m stuffed.”
gist: At his daughter's pretend dinner party, dad voices the teddy bear declining food because he is 'stuffed'.

text: My son didn't cope well with going to jail. He refused to eat or drink anything. He swore at everyone and covered his room with his own shit.After that, we never played Monopoly again.
gist: Parent describes a son's furious breakdown after 'going to jail', which turns out to be in a game of Monopoly.

text: I farted in the Apple store, and everyone got mad. It's not my fault that they didn't have Windows.
gist: Speaker farts in the Apple store and blames them for not having Windows, the Microsoft OS and openable windows.

text: I gave up my seat to a blind person on the bus. That’s how I lost my job as a bus driver.
gist: Speaker gave up his seat on the bus to a blind person, revealing he was the driver and lost his job.

text: A man on one side of a river shouts to a man standing on the other side, “Hey, how do I get to the other side of the river?” The other man responds, “You are on the other side of the river.”
gist: A man asks someone across a river how to get to the other side and is told he is already on the other side.

text: I said to my wife, "They say that childbirth is the most painful thing someone can experience..." "Now, maybe I was too young to remember, but I didn't think it hurt that much."
gist: Husband dismisses childbirth pain because, as the baby being born, he didn't find it that bad.

text: I was on the phone with my wife and said, "I'm almost home, honey, please put the coffee maker on." After a twenty second pause, I asked, "You still there sweetheart?" "Yeah…" she replied. "But I don't think the coffee maker wants to talk right now…"
gist: Husband asks wife on the phone to put the coffee maker on, and she takes it as handing the coffee maker the phone.

text: The Sun and Moon walked into a coffee shop today... Sun: "Oh man, I forgot my wallet!"Moon: "Don't worry, I'll cover you."
gist: Sun forgets his wallet at a coffee shop and the Moon offers to cover him, meaning both paying and an eclipse.

text: Dad, why do scuba divers roll backwards off the boat? Because, son, if they rolled forwards they'd still be in the boat.
gist: Son asks why scuba divers roll backward off boats and dad explains that rolling forward would land them in the boat.

text: My wife sighed, "Why does everything have to be a game with you?" "An excellent question sweetheart!" I said. "But next time, please use the buzzer!"
gist: Wife complains that her husband turns everything into a game, and he praises her question like a quiz host and asks her to use the buzzer next time.

text: Not to brag, but yesterday I beat the state chess champion in less than five moves. Finally my high school karate lessons came to some use.
gist: Man brags he beat the state chess champion in a few moves, then reveals he used karate, so the beating was physical.

text: I told my wife she drew her eyebrows abit high today she seemed suprised
gist: Husband tells his wife she drew her eyebrows too high, and her reaction looks surprised both because of the comment and because of the eyebrows.

text: [At the wedding] Priest: Repeat after me... Groom: After me..Priest, looking at bride: Is he serious?Bride: No, his name is Mike.
gist: At a wedding the groom literally repeats the priest's instruction words, and when the priest asks if he is serious the bride says no, his name is Mike, hearing the star name.

text: Dad (having an heart attack): Son call me an ambulance... Son actually calls an ambulance. Dad dies of disappointment.
gist: Dad having a heart attack asks his son to call him an ambulance, the son simply calls one instead of making the expected pun, and dad dies of disappointment.

text: I refused to believe my dad got fired as a road worker for theft. But when I got home, all the signs were there.
gist: Son doubts his road-worker father was fired for theft until he finds the house full of stolen road signs, punning on 'signs' as evidence.

text: I told my girlfriend she was drawing her eyebrows on too high the other day,  she looked surprised.
gist: Man tells his girlfriend she draws her eyebrows too high, and her reaction looks surprised because the high eyebrows make her look permanently surprised.
